# Papa Perez FC

> Official website of Papa Perez FC, a semi-professional football (soccer) club founded in 2025 at the Institute of Management Sciences (IMSciences), Peshawar, Pakistan. Founded by [Aadil Kamal Khan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aadil-kamal-khan-ai/).

## Pages

- [Home](https://aadilkk18.github.io/PapaPerez/): About the club, full squad list with positions and shirt numbers, and contact details.

## Club

- Founder: [Aadil Kamal Khan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aadil-kamal-khan-ai/)
- Current President: Farhan Aziz — since 2026 (also plays Forward, #9)
- Founded: 2025, at IMSciences, Peshawar
- Motto: "Loved, Despised, Never Ignored"
- Belief: "No one is bigger than the club."
